# SugarMount

> SugarMount is the developer name used by simpest, an independent developer, to publish apps on Google Play. Ten SugarMount apps are on Google Play, from a Korean spelling checker and an HWP viewer to photo tools and two puzzle games.

Contact: sugarmount21@gmail.com. Korean pages live at https://mvgood21.github.io/, English pages at https://mvgood21.github.io/en/.

- [All apps](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/) · [앱 전체 (Korean)](https://mvgood21.github.io/apps/)
- [About SugarMount](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/about/) · [소개 (Korean)](https://mvgood21.github.io/about/)
- [RSS feed (English)](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/rss.xml) · [RSS 피드 (Korean)](https://mvgood21.github.io/rss.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://mvgood21.github.io/sitemap.xml)

## Apps

- [SugarSpeller / 한글 띄어쓰기](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/sugarspeller/): Fixes Korean spelling and spacing in one pass, from pasted or shared text. Package com.sugarmount.sugarspeller, on Google Play.
- [SugarCard / 생생카드](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/sugarcard/): Make Lunar New Year, Chuseok and Christmas greeting cards and send them right away. Package com.sugarmount.sugarcard, on Google Play.
- [SugarAlbum / 슈가앨범](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/sugaralbum/): Pick photos, get a video. Package com.sugarmount.sugaralbum, on Google Play.
- [SugarClip](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/sugarclip/): Copy text and it goes to your note app, and into your clip history. Package com.sugarmount.sugarclip, on Google Play.
- [Compress Image / 사진 용량 줄이기](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/image-compress/): Shrinks photos under a size limit, like 100 KB or 500 KB. Package com.sugarmount.sugarcompress, on Google Play.
- [Flip & Rotate Image / 사진 반전·회전](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/image-flip/): Flip and rotate photos, saved as new files. Package com.sugarmount.sugarflip, on Google Play.
- [Convert Image JPG PNG WEBP / 이미지 변환 JPG·PNG·WebP](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/image-convert/): HEIC, PNG and WebP to JPG and more, in batches. Package com.sugarmount.sugarconvert, on Google Play.
- [HWP Viewer SugarDoc / 한글뷰어 슈가독](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/doc-viewer/): Open Korean HWP/HWPX documents and PDFs you receive, and find them again. Package com.sugarmount.sugardoc, on Google Play.
- [Arrow Knots / 화살표 매듭풀기](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/arrow-knots/): Slide tangled arrows out one by one and clear the board. Package com.sugarmount.arrows, on Google Play.
- [Block Turn / 한판블록](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/blocks/): A block puzzle: turn a stuck board around with three set pieces. Package com.sugarmount.blocks, on Google Play.
- [AXFamily](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/privacy/axfamily/): Share family plans and things to bring in one place. Package com.sugarmount.axfamily, coming soon.
- [CarDrawer / 차서랍](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/cardrawer/): One drawer per car. AI files every receipt and flags what's missing. Package com.sugarmount.cardrawer, coming soon.

## Facts

- Who makes SugarMount apps? SugarMount is the developer name used by simpest, an independent developer, to publish apps on Google Play. Planning, development and support are all done by the same person.
- Are my photos or documents uploaded? Compress Image, Flip & Rotate Image, Convert Image, HWP Viewer SugarDoc and SugarAlbum process files on your device without uploading them. SugarSpeller sends the text you check to the Naver or Daum spelling checker. Each app's privacy policy has the details.
- Are the apps free? All apps are free to install. Some show ads and offer ad removal or Pro features as a one-time purchase or subscription. HWP Viewer SugarDoc has no ads.
- How do I get support or report a bug? Email sugarmount21@gmail.com. Including the app name, device model and Android version helps us check faster.

## Help articles (English)

- [We're looking for 5 pilot dealerships](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/cardrawer/pilot/): CarDrawer is recruiting 5 pilot dealerships: used-car shops of 2 to 10 people in Korea that buy and resell their own stock. 4 weeks free, then the standard rate with a 12-month founding-customer price lock and setup help.
- [Pricing](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/cardrawer/pricing/): CarDrawer pricing: Solo ₩59,000, Team ₩149,000, Dealership ₩299,000 per month excluding VAT. 14-day free trial with no card and no automatic billing. No overage charges without consent.
- [Convert an HWP file to PDF on Android](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/doc-viewer/hwp-to-pdf/): Open the HWP or HWPX file in SugarDoc, tap ⋮ and Save as PDF to make a PDF on your phone with no upload. Only the first 15 pages are saved.
- [HWP vs HWPX: what differs and how to open both](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/doc-viewer/hwp-vs-hwpx/): HWP is the older binary Korean word-processor format; HWPX packs XML files into a ZIP. Renaming one does not convert it. On Android, open both in one viewer.
- [How to open an HWPX or HWP file on Android](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/doc-viewer/hwpx-open/): Android phones have no built-in app for Korean HWP and HWPX files. Install a viewer, pick it from Open with, and fix it when it is missing or another app opens.
- [Resize an ID photo for Korean application uploads](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/image-compress/id-photo-size/): Set a limit such as 500 KB in Compress Image and your ID photo is saved as a JPEG under it. It does not crop, so crop first when a site fixes pixel sizes.
- [Compress a photo to under 100 KB on Android](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/image-compress/photo-under-100kb/): Galaxy Gallery's Resize works by percentage, not file size. Compress Image fits each photo under a KB limit you set, like 100 KB, and flags any it can't fit.
- [Convert HEIC to JPG on a Samsung Galaxy phone](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/image-convert/heic-to-jpg/): Old HEIC photos need a converter app or a PC to become JPG. Convert Image does batches on the phone with no upload; HEIC the phone can't decode fails alone.
- [PNG to JPG on Android with a white background](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/image-convert/png-to-jpg/): Turning a PNG into a JPG on Android always fills transparent areas with one solid colour. How to pick white and convert several files on the device.
- [Unmirror a selfie on a Samsung Galaxy phone](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/image-flip/unmirror-selfie/): Flip a selfie you already took left to right and save it as a new photo: Google Photos for one picture, Flip & Rotate Image for a whole batch.
- [Korean Christmas greeting card messages](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/sugarcard/christmas-greetings/): Korean Christmas messages for family, friends and colleagues with English meanings, and how to send one on a card as an image or a 9-second snowfall video.
- [Spell-check long Korean text on Android](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/apps/sugarspeller/long-text-check/): Korean web spell checkers take 300 or 1,000 characters at a time. SugarSpeller checks up to 3,000 for free and up to 7,000 with a subscription on Android.

## Help articles (Korean)

- [파일럿 상사 5곳을 모십니다](https://mvgood21.github.io/apps/cardrawer/pilot/): 차서랍(CarDrawer) 파일럿 상사 5곳 모집. 직접 매입·재판매하는 2~10인 중고차 매매상사 대상, 4주 무료 후 정상가, 창립 고객 12개월 가격 고정과 설정 대행.
- [요금](https://mvgood21.github.io/apps/cardrawer/pricing/): 차서랍(CarDrawer) 요금: 개인 59,000원, 팀 149,000원, 상사 299,000원(월, 부가세 별도). 14일 무료 체험은 카드 없이, 자동 결제 없음. 초과 사용분은 동의 없이 청구하지 않습니다.
- [핸드폰에서 HWP 한글 파일을 PDF로 저장하는 법](https://mvgood21.github.io/apps/doc-viewer/hwp-to-pdf/): 한글뷰어 슈가독의 ⋮ 메뉴 'PDF로 저장'을 쓰면 HWP·HWPX 문서를 업로드 없이 휴대폰에서 PDF로 만들 수 있어요. 긴 문서는 처음 15쪽까지 저장되고, 배포용 문서는 저장할 수 없어요.
- [HWP와 HWPX 차이, 휴대폰에서 둘 다 여는 법](https://mvgood21.github.io/apps/doc-viewer/hwp-vs-hwpx/): HWP는 한글의 바이너리 형식이고 HWPX는 XML을 ZIP으로 묶은 개방형 형식이에요. 확장자만 바꿔서는 서로 바뀌지 않으니, 휴대폰에서는 두 형식을 모두 여는 뷰어로 보면 돼요.
- [카톡·휴대폰에서 HWPX 파일이 안 열릴 때](https://mvgood21.github.io/apps/doc-viewer/hwpx-open/): 휴대폰에는 보통 HWPX·HWP 파일을 여는 앱이 없어요. 한글 뷰어를 설치해 카톡의 '다른 앱으로 열기'에서 고르고, 목록에 없거나 다른 앱이 먼저 열리면 설정을 확인하세요.
- [갤럭시에서 증명사진 용량 줄이는 법](https://mvgood21.github.io/apps/image-compress/id-photo-size/): 사진 용량 줄이기 앱에서 상한을 500KB처럼 정하면 증명사진을 그 아래 JPEG로 줄일 수 있어요. 비율에 맞춰 자르지는 않으니 여권처럼 픽셀 규격이 있으면 먼저 잘라야 해요.
- [갤럭시에서 사진을 100KB 이하로 줄이는 법](https://mvgood21.github.io/apps/image-compress/photo-under-100kb/): 갤러리 '크기 변경'은 해상도만 바꿔서 몇 KB가 될지 정할 수 없어요. '사진 용량 줄이기' 앱은 100KB·500KB처럼 정한 상한 아래로 사진을 줄이고, 못 맞추면 실패로 알려 줘요.
- [갤럭시에서 HEIC 사진을 JPG로 바꾸는 법](https://mvgood21.github.io/apps/image-convert/heic-to-jpg/): 이미 찍은 HEIC 사진은 변환 앱이나 PC로 JPG 새 파일을 만들어야 해요. 이미지 변환 앱은 여러 장을 업로드 없이 휴대폰 안에서 바꾸지만, 기기가 읽지 못하는 HEIC는 그 장만 실패해요.
- [갤럭시에서 PNG를 JPG로 바꾸는 법, 투명 배경은?](https://mvgood21.github.io/apps/image-convert/png-to-jpg/): 갤럭시에서 PNG를 JPG로 바꾸면 투명한 부분이 한 가지 색으로 채워져요. 배경을 흰색으로 정해 업로드 없이 여러 장을 바꾸는 순서와 한계를 정리했어요.
- [갤럭시 셀카 좌우반전, 이미 찍은 사진 되돌리는 법](https://mvgood21.github.io/apps/image-flip/unmirror-selfie/): 이미 찍은 셀카는 좌우 반전해 새 사진으로 저장하면 돼요. 한 장은 Google 포토의 좌우 반전으로, 여러 장은 사진 반전·회전 앱으로 원본을 그대로 둔 채 한 번에 바꿀 수 있어요.
- [크리스마스 인사말 문구와 카드, 휴대폰으로 보내는 법](https://mvgood21.github.io/apps/sugarcard/christmas-greetings/): 크리스마스 인사말은 받는 사람에 맞춘 한두 문장이면 충분해요. 생생카드에서는 직접 쓴 문구를 크리스마스 카드 29장 중 하나에 얹어 이미지나 눈 내리는 9초 영상으로 보낼 수 있어요.
- [맞춤법 검사기 글자 수 제한, 휴대폰으로 긴 글 검사](https://mvgood21.github.io/apps/sugarspeller/long-text-check/): 웹 맞춤법 검사기는 한 번에 300자나 1,000자까지만 받아요. 자기소개서처럼 긴 글은 휴대폰 앱 한글 띄어쓰기로 무료 3,000자, 구독하면 최대 7,000자까지 한 번에 검사할 수 있어요.

## AX notes

How SugarMount apps are built and shipped with an AI coding agent, with measured numbers. Index: https://mvgood21.github.io/en/ax/ · Korean: https://mvgood21.github.io/ax/

### [Working with agents](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/ax/topic/workflow/)

- [How to write AGENTS.md: only the rules an AI coding agent gets wrong](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/ax/agents-md/): AGENTS.md is the file an AI coding agent reads before it works. Ours has 96 lines, lists only the rules the agent gets wrong, and enforces key ones with tests.

### [Testing and release](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/ax/topic/quality/)

- [The agent said it was tested. The game crashed on the first tutorial tap: a missing VIBRATE permission and the fresh-install monkey test](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/ax/fresh-install-monkey-test/): Our AI agent called a puzzle game crash-free, then it died on the first tutorial tap: a missing VIBRATE permission. adb monkey on clean data hit it at event 15.
- [What to check before shipping an AI-built Android app: the release gate and an R8 crash](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/ax/release-gate/): Our Android app ran fine in debug but crashed at launch in release after R8 removed a constructor. Now every upload passes three pre-release checks.

### [Android development](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/ax/topic/android/)

- [Building an Android HWP viewer: rhwp in a WebView, measured on 222 documents](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/ax/hwp-viewer-rhwp-webview/): The open-source rhwp engine in an Android WebView opened 221 of 222 Korean HWP/HWPX files on a Galaxy S21; a 384-page file needed virtual scrolling.

### [Game development](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/ax/topic/games/)

- [Block puzzle difficulty: how simulation bots caught a game you could never lose](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/ax/block-puzzle-bot-playtest/): Our block puzzle spec promised every tray could always be placed. A planning bot then played 80 games; all 80 hit the 3,000-move cap. How two bots set the fix.

### [Retrospectives and numbers](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/ax/topic/retro/)

- [How we shipped four Android apps in 20 days with an AI coding agent](https://mvgood21.github.io/en/ax/20-days-4-apps/): A solo developer and Claude Code put four Android apps on Google Play within 20 days of the first commit. 52 of 59 commits were co-authored with the agent.
